Allah raised some messengers above others, spoke to some and gave Jesus clear proofs, yet those after them differed and fought, some believing and some disbelieving.
No prophet would tell people to worship him, angels or prophets, and Allah took the prophets' covenant to believe in and support a messenger confirming what they had.
Those who believe in some messengers and reject others are truly disbelievers facing a humiliating punishment, while those who believe in all without distinction will be rewarded.
Allah revealed to the Prophet as He did to Noah and later prophets, spoke directly to Moses, and sent messengers with good tidings and warnings so mankind has no argument.
After a gap between messengers, Allah's Messenger has come to the People of the Scripture as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, leaving them no excuse.
Messengers are sent only to bring good tidings and warn: believers who reform have no fear or grief, while those who deny the verses will be punished.
Allah guided Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Noah, David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, Aaron, Zechariah, John, Jesus, Elias, Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah and Lot; follow their guidance.
Every prophet was given enemies, devils from mankind and jinn, who inspire one another with decorative speech that draws those who disbelieve in the Hereafter.
Jinn and mankind will admit messengers came to warn them; Allah would not destroy cities for wrongdoing while their people were unaware, and all have degrees by their deeds.
Messengers were sent after Noah to their peoples with clear proofs, but they would not believe what they had denied before.
The stories of the messengers are related to make the heart firm, bringing the truth, an instruction and a reminder for the believers.
The messengers before were men of the cities given revelation; when they despaired, victory came and whoever Allah willed was saved, and His punishment is not turned from criminals.
Messengers before had wives and descendants and brought signs only by Allah's permission; Allah eliminates or confirms what He wills, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.
Every messenger was sent speaking his people's language to make things clear; Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills.
Polytheists say that had Allah willed they would not have worshipped others; messengers only convey clearly, and one was sent to every nation: worship Allah and avoid Taghut.
The messengers before were men given revelation, clear proofs and scriptures, and the message was revealed to the Prophet to make clear to people what was sent down.
Before believing, they demand a spring, a garden, the sky falling, Allah and the angels, a house of gold or a book; but humans are sent a human messenger.
These were the prophets Allah favored, descendants of Adam, of those carried with Noah, and of Abraham and Israel, who fell weeping in prostration at His verses.
The messengers before were men given revelation, who ate food and were not immortal; Allah kept His promise, saving them and those He willed and destroying the transgressors.
Ishmael, Idrees and Dhul-Kifl were all patient, admitted into Allah's mercy and counted among the righteous.
Allah chooses messengers from the angels and from people, knows what is before and after them, and to Him all matters return.
Allah tells the messengers to eat good food and do righteous work, for their religion is one, but people split it into sects, each rejoicing in its own.
Every messenger before the Prophet ate food and walked in the markets, and Allah has made some people a trial for others to see who is patient.
Allah sent messengers with clear evidence to their peoples before the Prophet, took retribution on those who committed crimes, and supporting the believers was due upon Him.
Allah took a solemn covenant from the prophets, including the Prophet, Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus, to question the truthful about their truth, and prepared punishment for disbelievers.
If they deny the Prophet, messengers before him were also denied, and all matters return to Allah.
The Prophet is only a warner sent with truth; every nation had a warner, and earlier messengers bringing clear proofs and scripture were also denied, so Allah seized the disbelievers.
Allah's word went before that His messengers would be helped to victory and His soldiers would overcome, so the Prophet is told to leave the disbelievers awhile until punishment descends.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob were chosen for remembering the Hereafter, and Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl are among the outstanding.
Allah will support His messengers and the believers in this world and on the Day the witnesses stand, when the wrongdoers' excuses will not benefit them.
Messengers were sent before, some whose stories are told and some not, and no messenger brought a sign except by Allah's permission.
Every messenger before was called a magician or madman by a transgressing people; the Prophet is told to leave them, not being blamed, and to remind, for reminding benefits believers.
Allah sent messengers with Scripture and the balance for justice and sent down iron; He sent Noah and Abraham, then Jesus with the Gospel, whose followers innovated monasticism.
Allah sent a Messenger as a witness over them, just as He sent a messenger to Pharaoh, who disobeyed him and was seized with a ruinous seizure.
